# Suprabhat's Lab

> Free, open frontend tools and explainers at lab.suprabhat-dev.com. No sign-up, no paywall, no tracking. Built by Suprabhat Kumar (https://suprabhat-dev.com). Slogan: "Web for all, all for web."

Every tool pairs an interactive answer with a long-form explainer. Pages are static HTML and work without JavaScript as read-only examples.

## Tools

- [CSS Specificity Wars](https://lab.suprabhat-dev.com/specificity/): Compare CSS selectors, see each part's weight, expand nesting and walk the full cascade to find out which rule wins and why.
- [Selector Playground](https://lab.suprabhat-dev.com/playground/): Type any CSS selector and instantly see every part, what it contributes to specificity, and warnings about deprecated or risky patterns.
- [Stylesheet Audit](https://lab.suprabhat-dev.com/stylesheet-audit/): Audit pasted CSS with a specificity graph, sortable selector table, layer order and findings. Spot ID weight, deep selectors and important declarations.
- [Accessible Name Wars](https://lab.suprabhat-dev.com/accessible-name/): Find which label names a button, link, input or image. Follow the accessible name algorithm, inspect competing sources, and fix common labeling mistakes.
